description: This file contains unit test code for the ParagraphIterator class within the MigraDoc rendering engine. It provides methods to traverse paragraph elements forward and backward, extracting the sequence of element types and content.

classes.name: TestParagraphIterator
classes.description: A test utility class for iterating over paragraph elements in MigraDoc, with methods to retrieve forward and backward sequences of paragraph element types and content.

methods.name: GetIterators
methods.description: Traverses the paragraph elements from beginning to end, returning a string that represents the sequence of element types and their content.

methods.name: GetBackIterators
methods.description: Traverses the paragraph elements from end to beginning, returning a string that represents the sequence of element types and their content.
